prototypeTopology.limitation: Figma composition and targeted final renders were verified. Running-app behavior is not verified by this design audit.

instructionUpdate.evidence: Repeated custom rows, unlabeled branches, hierarchy drift, and visual-only failures showed that reuse, taxonomy, parent workflow ownership, and render verification need durable rules.
instructionUpdate.exactWording: Build every product screen from canonical components, variants, slots, and established patterns first. Before drawing any custom layer, inspect Section, ListRow, Lockup, ButtonGroup, ContainedIcon, and relevant templates or their local equivalents; extend their slots or variants when the need is reusable. A one-off component or hand-drawn product layer is a last resort and must document why canonical components cannot express the requirement.
